1.consolidated_definition: Herbácea de tallo recto, ramoso en la base, glabro o cubierto de un polvo escamoso; vegeta en terrenos húmedos; sus flores on pequeñas, purpurinas. (Ammania latifolia; humilis). Stahl, 4, 127.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Herbaceous plant with a straight, branching stem at the base, glabrous or covered with a scaly powder; it thrives in moist soils; its flowers are small and purplish. (Ammania latifolia; humilis). Stahl, 4, 127.
